component.name: PaperFlow
component.summary: Fast, personal, on-device PDF management studio

description.p: PaperFlow is a clean, modern desktop PDF studio built for Linux and Android. All operations are processed natively and directly on your device with pure Rust performance.

ul.li: Merge multiple PDFs with intuitive drag-and-drop sequencing
Extract page ranges or burst documents cleanly
Rotate individual pages or entire documents with real-time interactive preview
Compress files with Extreme, Recommended, and High-Quality profiles
Convert PNG, JPG, and WebP images to multi-page PDFs
Inspect document structure and clear metadata for sharing

description.p: Release with native drag-and-drop workspace, dark obsidian UI, pure Rust manipulation engine, and desktop file dialog integrations.
